# Locally served dependencies

- Bootstrap CSS 5.3.8 — `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css`; MIT license in `bootstrap.LICENSE`.
- HTMX 2.0.10 — `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@2.0.10/dist/htmx.min.js`; license in `htmx.LICENSE`.

No CDN requests occur when using the app. These are pinned third-party assets; do not format/edit their minified contents. Update deliberately with license review and browser checks.

The book icon in `static/brand.svg` is a project-created placeholder, not the University's official seal. Mangal is referenced as a locally installed font; no Microsoft font binaries have been redistributed.
